notes.title: New memory game with 50 new girls.
notes.notes: New game added to Girl Card Battle. It's the typical memory game but not as boring as the rest. Visually appealing, featuring your favorite girls. 50 girls will randomly appear to brighten your day.

notes.title: Limitation of cards in player's hand
notes.notes: Fixed the problem of excessive number of cards in the player's hand. The number of cards is limited to 5. This improves and makes the choice of cards and where to place them more exciting and makes handling the cards more comfortable.
